title: Declare inference attachment facts at trusted payload boundaries
summary: Explicit processor scopes reject unknown attachment counts; concrete text and image senders must supply facts without weakening inherited task policy.
reusable_steps: Explicit processor scopes reject unknown attachment counts; concrete text and image senders must supply facts without weakening inherited task policy
expected_outcome: When extending reasoning egress scopes, construct attachment_count at the concrete trusted payload boundary: zero for a text-only prompt, the outgoing image count for vision. An omitted count is unknown and must fail closed for an explicitly processor-scoped charter. Generic task, dot and pipeline envelopes cannot assume zero before their payload is known. Preserve inherited backend allowlists, external-egress restrictions, tenant context and provider endpoint checks while adding facts. Verify missing, negative and fractional counts, real image counts and text-only callers; run leak checks separately from builds to avoid counting concurrent compiler output as test pollution.
